subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about first-purchase volume for your electronics app. The picture has shifted: UK digital ad spend is forecast to hit £45 billion in 2026 with retail media a fast-growing channel, and Argos keeps expanding its own retail media inventory, so paid demand for the same electronics buyer keeps climbing. Consumer electronics CAC already runs from $100 to $377 or more, the highest band in ecommerce. That spread is where return-adjusted purchase optimization and a holdout set your real cost per net-new order. Worth a quick comparison?
angle: fresh angle: UK retail media surge to £45bn 2026 + Argos retail media move (sourced) + electronics CAC $100-$377 band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce/electronics (UK): acknowledges 2nd follow-up and references prior; fresh angle = timely development (UK digital ad spend forecast £45bn 2026 with retail media fastest-growing per IAB UK; Argos expanding retail media inventory per Zenbundle teardown) + market benchmark (consumer electronics CAC $100-$377+ per Eightx, web-verified). Named peer Argos from brand_candidates only; no cross-border giant as local rival. MobUpps holdout referenced with no figure; zero MobUpps numbers this stage. Exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no hedge before a number; no 'X, not Y'; no em-dash; native business English.
